title: Catalog controls
responsibility: Searches the entities on each catalog list page.

inputs.name: ExplorerControls.noun
inputs.description: Name of the entities being searched, documented in the code as plural and lowercase (for example pages or components), interpolated unchanged into the search container's aria-label `Find {noun}`, the input's aria-label `Search {noun}` and its placeholder `Search {noun}…`. The component does not validate or normalize it, so a value in another letter case or grammatical number is rendered exactly as passed.

inputs.name: ExplorerControls.filter
inputs.description: The CatalogFilter object whose `search` string this control reads and writes through `bind:value`; the control never reads or changes `changedOnly` or `order`. The prop is declared without a `?` marker and `$bindable()` gives it no fallback, so when a parent passes no value, `filter` is undefined and rendering throws a TypeError.

outputs.name: ExplorerControls
outputs.description: Markup for an hx-div with role `search`, class `ex-controls` and aria-label `Find {noun}`, holding an hx-label (class `ex-search`) that wraps a search HarnessIcon at size 18 and an hx-input of type `search` with placeholder `Search {noun}…`, aria-label `Search {noun}` and value bound to `filter.search`. The component performs no filtering itself, and its flex layout applies only inside an ancestor with class `ex-content`, where the `ex-search` label grows to fill the row.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown while the component renders when no filter value is passed (filter is undefined), because the search input's binding reads filter.search without a guard.
